highlights: Release date set for 4 September 2026
Features a new standalone story, not a recap of the series
Brings back fan‑favorite characters like Munna Bhaiya

content_acquisition.headline: Netflix & Talpa Dutch Deal
content_acquisition.summary: Netflix will add over 300 episodes of Talpa’s SBS6 shows to its Dutch catalogue.
highlights: More than 300 Dutch TV episodes will join Netflix
Includes popular titles like Chateau Meiland and Het Roer Om
Exact rollout date not yet announced
